const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Visual, proprioceptive controller for the single SweetenCoffee episode.
+
+Uses only the service's robot state, RGB-D frames, and camera calibration.
+Subcommands support short, observed motions so the operator can inspect each
+stage of this one unrestartable episode.
+"""
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+OUT = Path('/app/output')
+STATE = OUT / 'controller_state.json'
+
+
+def robot():
+    return Robot()
+
+
+def state():
+    return json.loads(STATE.read_text()) if STATE.exists() else {}
+
+
+def save_state(s):
+    STATE.write_text(json.dumps(s, indent=2))
+
+
+def proprio(meta):
+    p = meta['proprio']
+    return dict(zip(p['layout'], p['now']))
+
+
+def q_from(p):
+    return np.array([p[f'robot0_joint{i}_pos'] for i in range(1, 8)])
+
+
+def xyz_from(p):
+    return np.array([p[f'eef_right_{a}'] for a in 'xyz'])
+
+
+def action(q, grip=-1, base=(0, 0, 0), torso=0, mode=-1):
+    return np.r_[q, grip, base, torso, mode]
+
+
+def submit_target(r, q, grip=-1, seconds=1.0, cam=None, note=''):
+    n = max(1, int(round(seconds / r.spec()['control_dt'])))
+    a = np.repeat(action(np.array(q), grip)[None, :], n, axis=0)
+    res = r.submit('joint_position', a, cameras=cam or [], video='none', note=note)
+    return res
+
+
+def observe(r, cams=None, depth=False, tag=None):
+    res = r.get_obs(cameras=cams or [], include_depth=depth, video='none')
+    if tag:
+        res.save(str(OUT / tag))
+    return res
+
+
+def calibrate(r, amplitude=0.035, dwell=0.8):
+    obs = observe(r)
+    p = proprio(obs.meta)
+    q0 = q_from(p)
+    x0 = xyz_from(p)
+    cols = []
+    data = []
+    for i in range(7):
+        q = q0.copy(); q[i] += amplitude
+        r1 = submit_target(r, q, seconds=dwell, note=f'Jacobian probe joint {i+1}')
+        p1 = proprio(r1.meta)
+        qi, xi = q_from(p1), xyz_from(p1)
+        dq = qi-q0
+        dx = xi-x0
+        cols.append((dq, dx))
+        data.append({'joint': i+1, 'q': qi.tolist(), 'xyz': xi.tolist(), 'dq': dq.tolist(), 'dx': dx.tolist()})
+        r0 = submit_target(r, q0, seconds=dwell, note='Return from Jacobian probe')
+        p = proprio(r0.meta)
+        q0, x0 = q_from(p), xyz_from(p)
+    # Each probe includes minor tracking in other joints: solve all 7 samples.
+    DQ = np.array([c[0] for c in cols]).T
+    DX = np.array([c[1] for c in cols]).T
+    J = DX @ np.linalg.pinv(DQ)
+    s = state(); s['J'] = J.tolist(); s['calibration'] = data; save_state(s)
+    print(json.dumps({'J': J.tolist(), 'final_q': q0.tolist(), 'final_xyz': x0.tolist(), 'meta': r0.meta['time_left_s']}, indent=2))
+
+
+def point_world(meta, cam, uv, depth):
+    c = meta['cameras'][cam]
+    K = np.array(c['intrinsic_cv']); T = np.array(c['cam2world_gl'])
+    u, v = uv; d = float(depth[int(v), int(u)])
+    p = np.array([(u-K[0, 2])*d/K[0, 0], -(v-K[1, 2])*d/K[1, 1], -d, 1])
+    return (T @ p)[:3]
+
+
+def goto(r, target, grip=-1, gain=0.65, max_step=0.08, iters=12, dwell=0.5, note='Cartesian move'):
+    target = np.array(target, dtype=float)
+    J = np.array(state()['J'])
+    hist = []
+    for it in range(iters):
+        o = observe(r)
+        p = proprio(o.meta)
+        q, x = q_from(p), xyz_from(p)
+        err = target-x
+        hist.append({'it': it, 'xyz': x.tolist(), 'err': err.tolist()})
+        print(it, 'xyz', np.round(x, 4), 'err', np.round(err, 4), flush=True)
+        if np.linalg.norm(err) < 0.009:
+            break
+        # Damped least squares, keeping orientation near its current pose by
+        # preferring the smallest joint displacement.
+        dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J @ J.T + 0.0008*np.eye(3), gain*err)
+        scale = min(1., max_step / max(np.max(np.abs(dq)), 1e-8))
+        dq *= scale
+        rr = submit_target(r, q+dq, grip=grip, seconds=dwell, note=note)
+        pp = proprio(rr.meta); qnew, xnew = q_from(pp), xyz_from(pp)
+        actual_dq = qnew-q
+        # Secant update of Jacobian using the observed change.
+        resid = xnew-x - J@actual_dq
+        J += np.outer(resid,actual_dq)/(actual_dq@actual_dq + 1e-5)
+        s=state();s['J']=J.tolist();s['last_move']=hist;save_state(s)
+    return hist
+
+
+def main():
+    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser();sub=ap.add_subparsers(dest='cmd',required=True)
+    sub.add_parser('calibrate')
+    ob=sub.add_parser('observe');ob.add_argument('tag');ob.add_argument('--depth',action='store_true')
+    g=sub.add_parser('goto');g.add_argument('x',type=float);g.add_argument('y',type=float);g.add_argument('z',type=float);g.add_argument('--grip',type=float,default=-1);g.add_argument('--iters',type=int,default=12)
+    h=sub.add_parser('hold');h.add_argument('--grip',type=float,default=-1);h.add_argument('--seconds',type=float,default=1.0)
+    args=ap.parse_args();r=robot()
+    if args.cmd=='calibrate':calibrate(r)
+    elif args.cmd=='observe':
+        o=observe(r,list(r.spec()['cameras']),args.depth,args.tag)
+        print('time_left',o.meta['time_left_s'],'xyz',xyz_from(proprio(o.meta)))
+    elif args.cmd=='goto':
+        goto(r,[args.x,args.y,args.z],grip=args.grip,iters=args.iters)
+    elif args.cmd=='hold':
+        p=proprio(observe(r).meta);res=submit_target(r,q_from(p),grip=args.grip,seconds=args.seconds,note='Grip hold')
+        print('time_left',res.meta['time_left_s'],'xyz',xyz_from(proprio(res.meta)))
+
+if __name__=='__main__':main()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
